summary:
I've been working on Keikochō, a Japanese-learning app I built for myself, and most of the interesting engineering this stretch has been about image generation, not code. I redid all 400+ illustrations to move away from a "young anime girl" default style that didn't fit a middle-aged guy learning kana — bold-ink manga instead, cast diversified across ages and genders. The best casting trick turned out to be simple: making a figure elderly overrides the model's defaults harder than any amount of negative prompting does. I also found a real bug hiding in the pipeline for weeks — a style prefix that was supposed to apply to every generated image was silently only reaching one of the two rendering paths, so a whole batch shipped without the negative prompts that were supposed to keep things tasteful.

The other thread has been the conversational practice mode. I measured how much variety the built-in personas actually had and found most of them were giving the same answer to every question — one character answered "like" to all twelve topics it could be asked about. So I rebuilt how a persona's opinions are generated, and separately made speaking-out-loud the default way to respond instead of picking from a list, while making sure that still counts as imitation practice rather than a memory test the learner hasn't earned yet.

On the infrastructure side, I run a small personal server mesh (five or six machines) that everything above depends on, and I spent a chunk of time hunting a class of bug that's bitten me more than once: something that fails completely silently. Docker's "restart unless stopped" policy, for instance, doesn't actually restart a container after a reboot if it had been explicitly stopped before shutdown — so a broker process I depend on sat dead for an hour with nothing complaining. I've been building small deadman-switch scripts that check on these dependencies every 15 minutes and heal them automatically, because I'd rather find these problems from a log line than from the app just quietly not working.

highlights.oneLiner: Fixed a restart-policy bug that left the GPU broker dead for an hour; added deadman checks.
